summary: Pop Culture Group filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a direct registered offering of 665,000 Class A Ordinary Shares at a negotiated $3.00 per share to a single investor, with no placement agent or underwriting discounts, per a September 22, 2026 securities purchase agreement. The September 22 close was $4.71, implying a roughly 36% discount. Shares list on Nasdaq under CPOP. No board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. Proceeds are ordinary capital raising, not a special situation; watch for dilution and price pressure given the discounted direct placement.
